newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark signs GSM pact with Slovakia.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark signs GSM pact with Slovakia.

text.p: Telecommunications group Tele Danmark said on Monday it had signed an alliance with EuroTel Bratislava, allowing the Danish firm's GSM subscribers to use their mobile telephones in Slovakia.
"The roaming accord means that Tele Danmark's GSM network also covers Slovakia now," Tele Danmark said in a statement.
"Our aim is to make as many deals like this as possible all over the world," a spokesman told Reuters.
"The deals follow international standards, meaning in practice that the two networks are linked to each other," he said.

Tele Danmark has similar arrangements with most eastern European countries, notably Slovenia, Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, Poland, Croatia, Hungary, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
